results.releaseNotes:
This is a bug fix version which addresses a few issues in the last version.  Most notably the inability to set up a connection with Strava is now fixed.

If you are having problems with the action button on the Ultra then please reboot the watch because that often fixes any issues with it.

Note: this version requires watchOS 9.2, which means that it will no longer run on the old series 3 watches which were released back in 2017.  Sorry about that.  It was a necessary restriction in order to work around an issue in recent versions of watchOS.
